title: 第12章 总统至尊套房！包月的那种？
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

很快，丸子和香菜选好了各自心仪的商品。

香菜看中了一款巴黎世家的厚底短靴。

售价4200！

不是她想买这么贵，而是奢侈品店的东西就是这么贵。

在她看中的所有靴子里，这款巴黎世家厚底短靴的价格，赫然是最低的。

另一边。

丸子看中了一款古驰品牌首饰——双G项链。

售价5200！

短靴和项链加在一起，消费近乎过万！

但，江辰脸上没有浮现一丝的肉痛。

只要财神爷开心，花点“小钱”并不算什么。

柜姐拿起计算器，确认好消费金额后，看向江辰，目光一片柔和：

“江先生您好，您本次消费9400元！”声音略带一丝颤抖。

三个精神小妹的消费，足以令她这个月的绩效指标，完成大半！

听到‘9400’这个数字，江辰没有一丝犹豫，选择扫码支付。

支付成功后，赵安妮下巴险些触地，心中暗吃一惊：

“这大哥……未免也太有实力了吧！”

她甚至有些后悔，第一次见面时，对江辰显露出不屑一顾的姿态。

幸好，自身魅力足够大。

要不然，铁定就错过了江辰这条大鱼。

反观丸子和香菜，倒是表现得格外淡定。

不过是小一万罢了。

她俩昨天可是亲眼见证，江辰花费三十五万，买下了光头房东的整栋公寓！

虽然江辰对此解释说，是朋友转钱给他，让他帮忙买。

但，二女却有一股敏锐的直觉。

江辰口中所谓的朋友，恐怕就是他自个儿。

这时，手机震动了一下，江辰看了一眼。

是银行发来的短信提醒，存款还有5万多。

这次消费前，还有400元返现额度没有使用。

于是，10倍返现后，收入4000！

算下来，这次奢侈品之行，江辰只支出8000多。

“哥，麻烦帮我戴一下！”

丸子手里拿着古驰项链盒，笑容甜美地对江辰说道。

江辰眉头轻皱，明明她旁边的香菜距离她最近一些。

这番操作，属于是舍近求远了。

不过财神爷的请求，江辰自然是有求必应。

他接过盒子，拿起其中的一串项链。

围着丸子白皙的天鹅颈，轻轻扣上。

目光下意识顺着丸子香肩下方看下去，这也太波涛汹……

咳咳，该死的邪念，给老子安分点！

江辰心里暗骂一句，迅速帮丸子戴好项链。

“OK。”江辰轻声道。

闻言，丸子原地美美转了一圈，“哥，好不好看？”

“那必须滴，非常好看！”

丸子唇角微扬，从盒子里拿出第二串项链。

“哥，我这是买一送一，男女各一款。剩下这一串，要不就给你戴？”

什么买一送一？

分明就是情侣同款！

“丸子姐，你好心机啊！”香菜撇了撇嘴。

一旁，赵安妮不由得竖起了大拇指。

她早知道，也买情侣套装了。

奢侈消费一波后，几人打车回到了挂壁公寓。

看到赵安妮还一路跟着，丸子顿时皱了皱眉：

“臭泥，你还跟着我们做什么？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Soon, Wanzi and Xiangcai chose their favorite products.

Xiangcai took a fancy to a Balenciaga thick-soled short boots.

Selling price 4200!

It's not that she wanted to buy something so expensive, but that things in luxury stores are just that expensive.

Among all the boots she had her eye on, the price of these Balenciaga thick-soled short boots was surprisingly the lowest.

other side.

Maranzi took a fancy to a piece of Gucci brand jewelry - a double G necklace.

Selling price 5200!

The short boots and necklace together cost nearly over RMB 10,000!

However, there was no trace of physical pain on Jiang Chen's face.

As long as the God of Wealth is happy, spending a little "little money" is nothing.

The counter sister picked up the calculator and after confirming the consumption amount, she looked at Jiang Chen with a soft look in her eyes:

"Hello Mr. Jiang, your purchase this time is 9,400 yuan!" The voice was slightly trembling.

The consumption of the three energetic girls is enough to complete more than half of her performance indicators for this month!

Hearing the number '9400', Jiang Chen didn't hesitate at all and chose to scan the QR code to pay.

After the payment was successful, Zhao Anni’s chin almost touched the ground, and she was secretly surprised:

"This big brother... is too powerful!"

She even regretted that she showed disdain towards Jiang Chen when they first met.

Fortunately, my own charm is great enough.

Otherwise, he would definitely have missed the big fish of Jiang Chen.

On the other hand, Meatballs and Coriander behaved particularly calmly.

It’s just a small ten thousand.

The two of them witnessed with their own eyes yesterday that Jiang Chen spent 350,000 to buy the entire apartment of the bald landlord!

Although Jiang Chen explained that it was a friend who transferred money to him and asked him to help buy it.

However, the two women have a keen intuition.

The so-called friend in Jiang Chen's mouth is probably himself.

At this time, the phone vibrated and Jiang Chen took a look.

It was a text message from the bank reminding me that I still have more than 50,000 yuan in deposit.

Before this consumption, there was still 400 yuan of cash rebate that had not been used.

So, after 10 times the cashback, the income was 4,000!

After all, Jiang Chen only spent more than 8,000 on this luxury trip.

"Brother, please put it on for me!"

Wanzi held the Gucci necklace box in his hand and said to Jiang Chen with a sweet smile.

Jiang Chen frowned slightly, it was obvious that Xiangcai next to her was closer to her.

This operation is to seek the far away at the expense of the near.

However, Jiang Chen naturally responded to the God of Wealth's request.

He took the box and picked up a necklace.

Wrap it around the ball's white swan neck and buckle it gently.

His eyes subconsciously followed the bottom of Wanzi's fragrant shoulders. This was too rough...

Ahem, damn those evil thoughts, please calm down for me!

Jiang Chen cursed in his mind and quickly helped Wanzi put on the necklace.

"OK." Jiang Chen said softly.

Hearing this, Wanzi spun around beautifully, "Brother, does it look good?"

"That's a must, it's very beautiful!"

The corners of Wanzi's lips raised slightly, and he took out the second necklace from the box.

"Brother, I'm buying one and getting one free, one for men and women. How about I give you the rest of the bunch?"

What buy one get one free?

It’s obviously the same style for couples!

"Sister Wanzi, you are so scheming!" Xiangcai curled her lips.

On the side, Zhao Anni couldn't help but give a thumbs up.

If she had known earlier, she would have bought a couple's set.

After a wave of extravagant spending, several people took a taxi back to the wall-mounted apartment.

Seeing Zhao Anni still following along, Wanzi frowned immediately:

"Smelly mud, why are you still following us?"
